verdicts.reason: The two are almost identical. In both, the CTA floats on the right in the gap between the subhead and the pills, sitting so close above the flavour pills that it feels jammed. The headline runs to about 45px from the right edge against a 74px left margin, and the lower half is mostly dead space apart from a clipped peach circle. B edges ahead because its CTA's left edge lines up with the Honey Rosemary pill. A's CTA sits about 10px off that line, so it looks almost aligned but not quite.
